changelog.name: Cleaner-Royall-v4.8
changelog.body:
- This is Small Update with some bugs Fixed
   - Stream Closed Error now show exact error output
   - Increased maximum cleaning time to 30 seconds ( if exceed, try to clean remain waste again).
   - Fix : Crash Report Sender
   - Fix : Online Cleaner Premium Detection
   - Fix : Dalvik Cache option from one tap
   - Fix : Minor Text in Dynamic Action
   - Fix : Minor Texts & Improvements

For Any Help Please contact me on Telegram @CleanerRoyall
